text.Tidus: Listen to my story. This may be our last chance.

text.LOCATION: Dock in front of Tidus' house boat

text.ACTION: [crowd noise, fans run towards Tidus' house and wave as he emerges. Creepy Little Kid steps out of nowhere and joins crowd.]

CHOICE.ACTION: Talking to fans on dock (all optional/missible dialog is indicated with gray background)

CHOICE.Woman w/nerdy specs: I've been a big fan of yours. From the very beginning!

CHOICE.Man with Spiderman jacket: Yeah! We're cheering for you! You're Jecht's son! I'd be crazy not to cheer for you!

CHOICE.Woman in long skirt: Are you gonna show us that shot tonight?
You should do it! For us! The Jecht Shot. I'll be waiting!

CHOICE.Bahamut's Fayth: The game tonight ... It's very important.

text.Tidus: Nothing to worry about! Oh, if I score a goal ... I'll do this! (raises arms) That will mean it was for you, okay?

text.ACTION: (Titter)

text.Woman in pink top: East block in the front row!

text.ACTION: (Holds up ball)

CHOICE.Kid w/dreads: Your floating house ... It's cool! Can I see inside next time?

CHOICE.ACTION: (Giggle)

CHOICE.Kid in Abes T-shirt: Hey, show me how to play!
I want to be a blitzer, too!

CHOICE.ACTION: (AKA "5th from the right")

CHOICE.Redhead: Can I see you after the game?
Great! I know this great place ...

text.Tidus: Well, gotta go! Cheer for me!
Hey, I got a game to play!

text.Bahamut's Fayth: You can't tonight.

text.ACTION: (Three kids do odd bow / Yevon prayer)
[Tidus walks along, snorts at outdoor screen displaying Jecht's portrait.]

text.Zanar: I was in a coffee shop, running away from home when I heard the news. Our hero, Jecht, gone. Vanished into thin air! My dad must have been his biggest fan. I knew how sad he'd be. Heck, we all were that day. "Zanar," I says to myself, "What are you thinking?" I went running straight back home. We sat up talking 'bout Jecht all night. My dad and I never talked so much. Whoa ... Didn't mean to reminisce, folks. Anyway ... Ten years later, the Jecht Memorial Cup tournament is today! The two teams that have won through to the finals are ... of course, the Abes from A-East, and the Duggles from C-South. I know there's a lot of people out there today to see the star of the Abes! In just one year, he's become the team's number one player! He's Jecht's blood, and the new hope of blitzball! What kind of super play will he show us today? Will we see his father's legendary shot? I don't think I'm the only one excited here, folks!

CHOICE.ACTION: Talking with locals en route (A few clones. Later, the game tries to avoid having clones in same area.)

CHOICE.Guy in yellow pants: It's gonna be a killer game tonight. I know it!
Tonight's game is gonna be one for the history books!

CHOICE.Guy in Spiderman jacket: You'd better hurry! The game can't start without you!
Show us your moves out there, man!

CHOICE.Woman in pink top: Hurry up! The game's about to start!

CHOICE.Kid w/dreads: You'd better win tonight, or I'll deck you one! Pow!
I wanna play on your team when I grow up, Tidus!

CHOICE.Man sitting in roadway: They say you've got some tricks even your old man couldn't do!
Dinner's on me if you win! I even saved a table for you.

CHOICE.Another guy in yellow pants: Well, well! If it isn't Jecht junior!
From the look on your face, you'd think you already won!

CHOICE.Woman clasping hands: Whoa ... I got the shivers. Maybe I'm coming down with something ...
Do you feel cold? Nah, maybe it's just me. Never mind.

CHOICE.Woman in long skirt: Careful, the Zanarkand Duggles mean business tonight!
I hear the Zanarkand Duggles play dirty!

CHOICE.Redhead: Hey, Mr. Star Player of the Abes! Do your stuff out there tonight!
Their defense won't know what hit them!

CHOICE.Girl running from person to person: Man, tickets for tonight's game cost an arm and a leg!
The tickets were all sold out! I hope someone's got some extra.
Can't you get me a ticket? I want to see the game up close.
R-Really? You're the greatest! How can I repay you? Here, have this! They'll let me in if I say "Tidus and I are buds," right? I won't tell anyone else. It'll be our secret!
Oh, well. It was worth a try. Aw, too bad ... I would have cheered for you. It's okay, really! I'll be fine here ... alone ...

CHOICE.Guy squatting by curb: I don't feel so good ... like I'm on a roller coaster going down.
Maybe all this excitement's gotten to me.

CHOICE.Kid w/bandana: Hit 'em with a Jecht Shot, okay?
Your dad was the best, Tidus. I wish I had a dad like yours!

CHOICE.Kid w/dreads: My mom's a big fan of yours, too! She said to invite you to dinner!

CHOICE.Kid in Abes T-shirt: Come on, you're gonna be late! Hurry! Hurry!

CHOICE.Yet Another guy in yellow pants: All of Zanarkand's watching now, so put on a show for 'em!
Show them what blitzball's all about!

CHOICE.Another woman in long skirt: I'm sure you'll get MPV this year.
You are Jecht's son, after all!

CHOICE.Another redhead: The Zanarkand Abes are counting on you! Don't let them down!
You'd better hurry ... Or are you just trying to warm up the crowd?

text.ACTION: [Tidus shoves his way through admirers gathered outside]

text.Tidus: Make way, make way! Coming through, sorry! Hey, I'm gonna be late! Hey, let go of me!

text.ACTION: Blitzball game. Enter Auron. Sin arrives and shreds the city. Tidus falls with a squawk as the stadium explodes.
[Screaming spectators flee stadium like rats leaving sinking ship. Tidus staggers to feet, approaches figure leaning against rubble.]

text.Tidus: Auron! What are you doing here?

text.Auron: I was waiting for you. (Walks away)

text.ACTION: [Tidus staggers along, opposite direction from running people. There's a flash, and Creepy Little Kid appears.]
[For an instant the running figures and the whole city are frozen.]

text.Bahamut's Fayth: It begins.
Don't cry.

text.ACTION: [Flash of light. Kid vanishes. Movement/chaos resumes.]

text.Tidus: (Catches up to him) Hey, not this way!

text.ACTION: Bubble of water hovers over Zanarkand.
Sin-tentacle punches through building and sheds sinscales.
[Sinscales fall on road surround them. Tidus bats at monsters, falls down. Auron holds out sword.]

text.Tidus: (Takes sword, stands up, can barely lift it)

text.Auron: I hope you know how to use it.

text.ACTION: [First battle]

text.Auron: These ones don't matter. We cut through!

text.ACTION: [More Sinscales]

text.Auron: Don't bother going after all of them. Cut the ones that matter, and run!

text.ACTION: [Boss Fight Tentacles]
[They run up the road past the viewscreen with Jecht]

text.Tidus: What are you laughing at, old man?
Auron! Let's get out of here!

text.ACTION: [Fight surrounded by even more Sinscales]

text.Auron: That–knock it down! (Points at contraption — "Tanker" — against curb)

text.ACTION: [Knock down tanker, triggering explosion]
[Both run. Tidus leaps as road collapses and catches far side, dangling by hands.]
[Tidus dangles, calling for help. Sin looms above, sucking up debris like black hole.]
(Hoists Tidus)

text.Auron: This is it. This is your story. It all begins here.

text.ACTION: [Auron is drawn into light, Tidus screams and gets pulled in too.]

text.LOCATION: Sin — Dream's End (or beginning, in this case)
Dreamlike, deserted Zanarkand. Flaming Abes symbol hangs behind a partial stadium.

text.ACTION: (Disembodied voice)

text.Jecht: Hey!
HEY!

text.ACTION: [Tidus swims towards fuzzy image of Jecht standing on platform. Jecht turns into Tidus as a child.]

text.Tidus: I thought about a lot of things ... like where I was, what I'd got myself into. I started to feel light-headed ... and then, sleepy. I think I had a dream. A dream of being alone. I wanted someone– anyone, beside me ... so I didn't have to feel alone anymore.

text.ACTION: [Tidus wakes up on pile of half-submerged rubble. Lightning flickers over large structure in distance.]
[Tidus swims towards structure]

CHOICE.SYSTEM: Sphere lying in lefthand ruins =Introduction to Al Bhed= Find Al Bhed primers to help you decipher the strange Al Bhed language. Master the Al Bhed language! Best of luck!

text.SYSTEM: On blue plaque in righthand ruins In the land where bolts of light illuminate the blackest night With Macalania behind the fourth pillar you sight look not on the left but on the right

text.Tidus: What do we have here? Nope. Can't read it.

text.ACTION: [Boss Fight with underwater monster, which almost swallows him.]
[Tidus flees into tunnel which collapses behind him.]

text.Tidus: I had made it out of the frying pan ... and into the freezer. I thought I was going to die in this place.

text.ACTION: [Gets a fire lit]
(Dozes off.)

text.LOCATION: Dream Sequence: Tidus’ room in Zanarkand

text.ACTION: [Auron stands in the doorway of Tidus' houseboat]

text.Auron: It was a bad call. Your team lost because of you.
It's been ... ten years. I thought you'd be crying.

text.Bahamut's Fayth: (Creepy kid suddenly in Auron's place) You cried.

text.ACTION: [A shadow skitters around upper level. Tidus awakens, discovers fire's dying.]

text.Tidus: Hey, wait! Wait! Don't go out on me! Just hold on. I'll get more wood!

text.ACTION: [Monster attacks. Boss battle.]
[Five Al Bhed arrive. Rikku helps.]
[They finish off monster]
[Bearded Al Bhed grabs Tidus.]

text.Rikku: Wait! What if it is human?

text.Gas mask guy: They are the same in death.

text.Rikku: I forbid it! We bring it with us.
(Walks up to Tidus, whispers ... ) Sorry. (Thwack)

text.ACTION: [Tidus wakes up and starts to rise]
(Thwack)
[Brother comes on deck with Rikku]
Rikku hoists Tidus to his feet, Brother gestures vigorously, mimes diving and swimming]
(Hands Tidus a breather and mimes for him to put it on)
(Thwack)

text.Rikku: Wait
He said you can stay if you make yourself useful.

text.ACTION: (Thwack)

CHOICE.ACTION: [Tidus peers at machinery folded on starboard rear deck]

CHOICE.Tidus: What's this? Some kind of crane?

CHOICE.Brother: Hey, you! Get away from there!

CHOICE.Tidus: All right, all right! You don't have to shout!

CHOICE.Brother: Move it! Get to work, immediately!

CHOICE.Keyakku: If you're near death, really near death, use this! Go on, earn your pay.

CHOICE.Gas mask guy: You afraid of the sea? Weakling!

text.Rikku: Oh, almost forgot!

text.ACTION: [Sphere Grid Tutorial]

CHOICE.ACTION: After Sphere Grid Tutorial…

text.Rikku: We found some ancient ruins right beneath us. It's not active now, but there should still be some power left. We're gonna go down there and activate it ... and then we should be able to salvage the big prize!
Okay! Let's get to work!

CHOICE.ACTION: If Tidus climbs back aboard…

CHOICE.Rikku: We'll go as soon as you're ready!

CHOICE.ACTION: Spikey will give more potions every time you re-surface!

text.ACTION: [Tidus and Rikku power up ruins, fight Nautilus, glimpse airship on sea bottom.]

text.Al Bhed in blue cap: Now, how to drag it up?

text.ACTION: (attempts to follow them below)
(Thwack)

text.Tidus: Hey! Hey, I helped out, didn't I?

text.ACTION: [Fast forward, Tidus lying on deck.]

text.Rikku: (Wakes him with a kick, puts down tray of food)

text.Tidus: Whoa! Right on! (Gobbles too fast, chokes)

text.Rikku: Hey! (Offers canteen) It's 'cause you eat too fast!
Hey!

text.Tidus: Hello there. What is your name?

text.Rikku: Rikku.

text.Tidus: Whoa! You really do understand! Why didn't you say so earlier?

text.Rikku: I didn't get a chance to! Everyone thought oui were a fiend.
Oh, "oui" means "you."

text.Tidus: Um ... Who are you guys, anyway?

text.Rikku: We're Al Bhed. Can't you tell?
Wait. You're not an Al Bhed-hater, are you?

text.Tidus: I don't even know what an Al Bhed is.

text.Rikku: Where are you from?

text.Tidus: Zanarkand. I'm a blitzball player. Star player of the Zanarkand Abes!

text.Rikku: Did you hit your head or something?
Oh, right ... Do you remember anything before that?

text.Tidus: So I told her everything there was to tell about Zanarkand ... About life there, blitzball, and Sin's attack ... and about how Auron and I were engulfed in this light. I just said things as they came to mind. But then I started to wonder.

text.Rikku: You were near Sin.
Don't worry, you'll be better in no time. They say your head gets funny when Sin is near. Maybe you just had some kind of dream?
Because of Sin's toxin, yeah.
Yeah, there is no Zanarkand anymore. Sin destroyed it a thousand years ago. So ... no one plays blitzball there.

text.Tidus: Huh?! What do you mean, a thousand years ago? But I saw Sin attack Zanarkand! You're saying that happened a thousand years ago? No way!

text.Rikku: You said ... You play blitzball?
You know, you should go to Luca. Someone might know who you are, or you might find someone you recognize.
(groans)
(wanders around a bit, then pats his shoulder) Okay, leave it to me! I'll get you to Luca, promise!
(laughs) You'd rather stay here?
Okay, I'll go tell the others. Wait here.
Oh, and one thing. Don't tell anyone you're from Zanarkand, okay? Yevon says it's a holy place. You might upset someone.
Hm.

text.ACTION: [Rikku leaves him alone on deck ... ]

text.Tidus: My Zanarkand, some kind of holy place? Yeah right, I thought. Since when?
Yevon? Sin? Luca? I thought Sin just took me to a faraway place, that I could go back in a day or two. But a thousand years into the future?

text.ACTION: [Ship shakes ... ]
[Al Bhed rush on deck]
[Wave sweeps Tidus overboard]
[Tidus wakes up spluttering]
[smacked by flying object]
[Wakka and Aurochs wave from beach]

text.Wakka: Hey! You okay?

text.Tidus: Heeey! (Waves back and shows off "Sphere Shot")

text.ACTION: [Tidus' shot flies off over the jungle.]

text.Wakka: Whoa-ho!

text.ACTION: [Tidus swims ashore. Gatta and Luzzu run off. Aurochs surround him.]

text.Wakka: You wanna try that move one more time?

text.Tidus: (fistpump) Finally, things were starting to look up. (demonstrates)

text.Wakka: You're no amateur. Who you play for?
What team you say again?

text.Tidus: Uh, I meant ... Forget that. I got too, uh ... close to Sin and my head's all foggy-like. So I don't know where this place is. Or even where I came from.

text.Wakka: Sin's toxin got to you. But, you're still alive. Praise be to Yevon!

text.ACTION: (Yevon bow)
(To Aurochs)

text.Wakka: All right, back to practice!

text.ACTION: (To Tidus)

text.Wakka: I'm Wakka, coach and captain of the Besaid Aurochs, brudda.

text.ACTION: (shakes hands)

text.Wakka: What? You hungry? Okay! Back to the village. I'll get you somethin'!

CHOICE.ACTION: If Tidus talks to Aurochs on the beach ...

CHOICE.Keepa: Hey, I'll admit it, we're not the best blitzers in Spira.
"To do our best!" That's our motto. Guess it's not enough, though. Here, take this. And do your best, ya?

We're always top dogs for the first few minutes of the game, ya? Then we start to run out of breath. That's when they get us. But Cap'n Wakka, man, he don't stop! No halftime breath for him, ya? He just keeps going!

CHOICE.Jassu: That shot was spectacular, brudda! Wish I could shoot like that.
Cap'n Wakka's waiting for you. You better get going, ya? There's fiends on the road, ya? Use this if you get into trouble.

CHOICE.ACTION: Gift : ~Potion

CHOICE.Datto: I gotta stop closing my eyes when the ball comes down.
You being a blitzball player's probably what saved you out there. The best players–they can hold their breath, like, forever! I wish I could do that.
We had an underwater race once, ya? To see how long we could go. Two laps and we were out, but Cap'n Wakka went five, no sweat!
That toxin's nasty stuff, ya? You should go rest up. What am I saying? Take this, it might help!

CHOICE.Letty: I can head the ball pretty good. Today's just a bad day, ya?
This is really weird, ya? I could do five in a row yesterday!
I'm nowhere near Cap'n Wakka, but I can hold my own underwater, ya? It's just that ... I'm not so good with the ball.
It true that the best players can even sleep underwater? Man, that's like ... superhuman, you know?

CHOICE.Botta: I really want to make Cap'n Wakka proud at this year's tournament.
Come practice with us once the toxin wears off, okay? Hope you get better soon, brudda.

CHOICE.ACTION: Gift : ~Potion

text.Tidus: I felt like I could trust this Wakka, so I just had to ask.
It's true Zanarkand was destroyed, right? A thousand years ago? So it's just a big pile of rubble now, isn't it?

text.Wakka: Long time ago, there were a whole lot of cities in Spira. Big cities with machina–machines–to run 'em. People played all day and let the machina do the work. And then, well, take a look.

text.ACTION: [view switches briefly to beach, ruins poking up through rainforest]

text.Wakka: Sin came, and destroyed the machina cities. And Zanarkand along with 'em. Yeah, that was about a thousand years ago, just like you said. If you ask me, Sin's our punishment for letting things get out of hand. What gets me, though ... is we gotta suffer, 'cause of what some goofballs did way back when! 'Course, we must always repent for our sins! That's important! It's just that, it's hard to keep at it sometimes, you know?

text.Tidus: It was just as Rikku said. Wakka and Rikku couldn't both be lying. Why would they?

text.Wakka: (Guffaws) But you from the Zanarkand Abes–that was a good one! Hey, I'm not saying the team never existed, ya? But you gotta figure a team livin' in luxury like that'd be pretty soft, eh?

text.Tidus: I appreciated the fact that Wakka was trying to cheer me up. But at that time, all I could think about was ... everything that happened to me–all this–started with Sin. Maybe if I could find Sin one more time, I could go home! For now, I'd just live life until that time came. No more worrying about where, or when, I was. Sure, it was hard not to think of home. But I started to feel better already. A little better ... maybe.

text.Wakka: Hey! It's this way!

text.ACTION: [Wakka leads Tidus to cliff overlooking river]

text.Wakka: (Slaps his butt)

text.ACTION: [They swim downriver a while]

text.Wakka: (laughs, sneaks up behind T. and grabs in headlock)
Got a favor to ask ya.

text.Tidus: You want me on your team, right?

text.Wakka: (Lets go) A major blitz tournament's coming up. All the teams in Spira'll be there! It's so huge, I'm sure someone there will recognize you! Then you can go back to your old team, right? It'll be fun! What do you say, huh? Come on, come on!
Dude! Our team is gonna rock, eh?

text.Tidus: I thought then that blitzball and Sin were the only two things that Spira and Zanarkand had in common. I wasn't too far off, either.

text.ACTION: [Wakka points at Besaid village spread out below them]

text.Wakka: This is where I was born. I started blitz when I was five. I joined the Aurochs at thirteen ... ten years ago.Ten years ... and we never won a game. Well, after last year's tournament, I quit. Time seemed right.
So, after quitting, I got this new job, ya? But every time my mind wandered, I thought about the game.

text.Tidus: Ten years without a single win'll do that.

text.Wakka: (Grunts) My first match last year was my big chance. But something else was on my mind. I couldn't focus.
Hey, hey!

text.Tidus: So you want to win the next tournament–go out with a bang.

text.Wakka: (Nods)
I don't care how we do. Long as we play our best. If we give it our all, I can walk away happy.

text.Tidus: No, no, no, no, no. If I say, "What's our goal?" you say, "Victory!" When you play in a blitzball tournament, you play to win!

text.Wakka: Victory? You serious?

CHOICE.ACTION: If Tidus tries the path back to the river before entering the village, his stomach grumbles and he changes his mind.

CHOICE.Wakka: it's an ancient custom. People leaving the island pray here for a safe trip. They say it works pretty good.

text.Luzzu: Ah, the one from the sea!

text.Gatta: Be on guard. There're fiends on the road today!

text.Luzzu: After surviving your run-in with Sin, 'twould be a shame if something happened now.

text.ACTION: [Luzzu and Gatta head towards village]

text.Wakka: Luzzu and Gatta–Crusaders.
What, you forgot that too?
Hey, sorry. Don't worry about it. I'll help you out.

text.Tidus: In return, come tournament time, I'll make sure we take the cup!

text.Wakka: Cool! About the Crusaders, you can ask them yourself. They've got a lodge in the village.
Besaid Village.
We'll get you something over there later. Take a look around first. Let's see ... The Crusaders Lodge is over yonder. Luzzu and Gatta are usually there.

text.ACTION: (Points)

text.Wakka: Hm.
Oh, right.

text.ACTION: (Beckons)

text.Wakka: Over here!
You do remember the prayer, right?

CHOICE.Tidus: I didn't know it in the first place, to tell the truth.

CHOICE.Wakka: Man, that's like the basics of the basics. Alright. I'll show you.

CHOICE.Tidus: Of course I'd never prayed before in my life. Not that he would know that ...

CHOICE.Wakka: You ... must have forgot or something. Here, I'll show you.

text.Wakka: (Yevon bow in slow-motion) Go ahead, you try.
Hey, not bad. (slaps shoulder) Okay, now go present yourself to the temple summoner. (Leaves)

text.Tidus: Any blitzball player would know that prayer. It was the blitzball sign for victory.

text.ACTION: [Tidus finds Gatta and Luzzu at a table poring over chart]

text.Gatta: Hey, you! You were attacked by Sin ... right? Recently was it?
So, Sin can't be far, right? You're not hiding anything, are you?

text.Luzzu: If Sin's nearby, it'll attack the island for sure. But it hasn't. I wonder why?

text.Tidus: I'm sorry. I really don't know anything. To tell the truth, I don't even know what the Crusaders are.

text.Luzzu: Sin! The toxin! Gatta, tell him who we are!

text.ACTION: (stands, salutes)

text.Gatta: The Crusaders are sworn to battle Sin! We have chapters throughout Spira, accepting all who wish to join our struggle! The hero Mi'ihen formed the Crusaders eight hundred years ago as the Crimson Blades. Later, our ranks grew and we called ourselves the Crusaders. We've been fighting Sin ever since!

text.Tidus: What, you've been fighting eight hundred years and you still haven't beat it?

text.ACTION: (Stammers)

text.Luzzu: Well, we've steered Sin away from towns many times! And that's all we can do. Nobody's ever been able to defeat it. Our mission as Crusaders is to protect the temples, towns, villages, and people of Spira.

text.Tidus: So then whose job is it to defeat Sin?

text.Gatta: Is Sin's toxin really this bad, sir?

text.Luzzu: We could just tell you, but I think it better for you to try and remember. Go pray at the temple. Perhaps Yevon will help you regain your memory.

CHOICE.Gatta: But soon, we may be able to finally defeat Sin. We've got a plan–one that'll go down in Crusader history!

CHOICE.Luzzu: We've been excommunicated from Yevon. We must go, now. Everything is riding on our next ... our last battle!

CHOICE.ACTION: In Besaid Village, there's one of each NPC model, and you can follow them around if you're really patient. They say different things in different parts of the village. My nicknames are based on comments they drop at different times.

CHOICE.Gramps: I heard the Sin toxin got to you. Took your memory, eh?
I'd be happy to teach you anything you've forgotten, sonny.

How could you forget Sin? I can't say I don't envy you, though. There's many who would give anything to forget the pain Sin has brought. Sin appeared a thousand years ago, a raging demon intent on reducing Spira to rubble. Everyone in Spira lives under Sin's shadow. But to forget Sin ... well, I'd consider yourself lucky, eh? Something else you'd like to know, eh?

The foul vapors that boil from Sin's hide are evil indeed ... One breath, and it will taint the very core of your body. People who get too close to Sin forget even the most important things. Just like you, eh? Something else you'd like to know, eh?

How wretched you must be, to have forgotten the teachings of Yevon! The teachings are the only salvation for those who suffer becasuse of Sin. I'm sure you followed the teachings, before the toxin got to you, of course. Go pray at the temple, and all will return in time. Something else you'd like to know, eh?

Zanarkand was once a great city in the far north of this land. Now it lies in a ruin, destroyed by Sin a thousand years ago. Such was its punishment for relying too much on machina. Something else you'd like to know, eh?

CHOICE.Tidus: No, thanks, I'll pass. [after receiving at least one answer, becomes ... ] No thanks, gramps.

CHOICE.Gramps: Maybe if I remind you of some things, you'll remember who you are! (Menu opens again)

CHOICE.Besaid Old Woman: Me favorite's Lord Ohalland, ya? Spitting image of me old hubby.

CHOICE.Yuna's little friend: Who are you, mister? Where you from?

CHOICE.Besaid Handyman: Sin's struck Besaid Village so many times I lost count. After this house got hit I guess the owner just let it be.
Sin will just come back and destroy it again. Sometimes I wonder why I bother.

CHOICE.Priestess: Besaid's devotion to the teachings of Yevon is commendable. Still, there is much for a priestess such a I to teach them.

CHOICE.Sailor w/blue cap: Is it true that Sin showed up near here? Oh boy! And the S.S. Liki's scheduled to leave any day now.

CHOICE.Portly Crusader: You should try praying. It worked for me–it'll work for you, too.

CHOICE.Vilucha's son: I can't figure out whether I'm gonna join the Aurochs or the Crusaders!
I'm pretty good at blitz, ya? I can hold my breath and everything!

CHOICE.Girl with doggie: You're the talk of the town, you know? Word travels fast in a village this size.

CHOICE.Weaver: On a hot day like today, it's best to be in the shade, ya?

CHOICE.Refugee: I travelled Spira looking for a land where nobody had heard of Sin. I ... I gave up looking. I think it's for the best.

CHOICE.Journeyman weaver: Sin's toxin? Nah, you don't look sick. You must not have breathed in much of the stuff, ya? Guess being a blitz player means you can hold your breath pretty good.
I wanted to be a blitzer way back when. I just couldn't hold my breath.

text.Yunalesca: Sorrow cannot be abolished. It is meaningless to try.

text.Yunalesca: Poor creature. You would throw away hope. Well ... I will free you before you can drown in your sorrow. It is better for you to die in hope than to live in despair. Let me be your liberator.

I've been wandering ever since, never going to the Farplane.

text.SYSTEM: Star player of the Zanarkand Abes. His attacks lack power due to his inexperience with the sword. Speed is his greatest asset. As a child he was a crybaby, and tears still come to him easily.

She was taken to Besaid after losing her father ten years ago. There she grew up with Wakka and Lulu, choosing to follow in her father's footsteps and become a summoner. Being very honest and open, she can't keep a secret for long.

The legendary guardian who, along with Jecht, joined High Summoner Braska on his journey to vanquish Sin ten years ago. After that victory, he left Spira for Zanarkand to watch over Tidus. Formerly a warrior monk, he once protected the temples of Yevon.

Yuna's guardian, and an accomplished black mage. She's guarded two summoners before Yuna, and learned much from those pilgrimages. No one, not even Wakka, knows how she controls the puppets she uses as weapons.

Yuna's blitzball-toting guardian. His training has honed the accuracy and power of his shots, which can take down both fast-flying fiends and enemies afar. He's a competent and versatile fighter, but he has yet to win an argument with Lulu.

A Ronso youth with a gift for mastering enemies' abilities, he abandoned his homeland over ten years ago and now watches over Yuna. He speaks only to those he deems worthy, but his fierce appearance belies a gentle heart.
An Al Bhed girl trying hard to protect Yuna. She makes up for her weak attacks with her superior speed. Her fear of lightning is just a phobia. She affectionately calls Yuna "Yunie" as a nickname.

A maester of Yevon and leader of the Guado, He seems disinclined to summon aeons, but his powers are great. He can draw upon magic of all four elements as well as upon healing spells. His Overdrive Requiem deals a devastating blow to all enemies.

text.ACTION: I've included the Jecht Spheres in the main Final Fantasy X script whenever you first encounter them, but for easy reference, I've excerpted the full set below in the order of Braska's pilgrimage. Also included Auron's, Braska's, Yuna's ... and Gippal's spheres.
[Evidently from a prison security camera. Braska enters; warrior monks give Yevon bow. Braska approaches cell.]

text.Jecht: Who are you?

text.Braska: You are the one they call Jecht, the man from Zanarkand, are you not?

text.Jecht: What of it?

text.Auron: (Trots into view) Watch your tongue, knave.

text.Braska: (Nods to Auron, then faces Jecht again) Ah. My apologies. I am Braska, a summoner. I've come to take you from this place.

text.Jecht: Hmm. Sounds sweet. What's the catch?

text.Braska: Ahhaha ... That easy to see, was it? I soon leave on a pilgrimage ... to Zanarkand.

text.Jecht: Seriously?

text.Braska: Mm. (Nods) I would like you to join us. It will be a dangerous trip. Yet, if we do reach Zanarkand ... my prayers will be answered, and you will be able to go home, we think. What say you?

text.Jecht: Great, let's go!

text.Braska: Hm. So quick?

text.Jecht: Anything to get outta here!

text.Braska: Then it's settled.

text.Auron: But I must protest ... This drunkard a guardian?

text.Jecht: Hey! You want to step in here and say that?

text.Braska: What does it matter? No one truly believes that I, a fallen summoner wed to an Al Bhed ... could possibly defeat Sin. This is what they say. No one expects us to succeed.

(Chuckles) Let's show them they're wrong. A fallen summoner, a man from Zanarkand, and a warrior monk, doomed to obscurity for refusing the hand of the priest's daughter. What delightful irony it would be if we defeated Sin!

text.Jecht: Stop gabbin' and get me outta here!

text.ACTION: [Recording clicks off, resumes a short time later with Jecht in main room]

text.Jecht: Ahh ... Free at last!

text.Braska: Now, Jecht ... I am in your hands until we reach Zanarkand.

text.Jecht: Right, right. So, what's a summer-ner, anyway?

text.ACTION: [Auron and Kinoc ten years ago]

text.Kinoc: I know I don't need to tell you this, but guard Lord Braska well.

text.Auron: That, I will. And you'll be busy, too. I heard they made you second-in-command.

text.Kinoc: (sigh) You know that promotion was meant for you. You were always the better one, even until the end.

text.Auron: You make it sound as if I was going to die or something. I will see you again.

text.Kinoc: Yes.
Going already?

text.ACTION: (nods)

text.Kinoc: You will tell me about Zanarkand when you return, won't you?

text.ACTION: Recording Braska and Guardians Leave Bevelle

text.Jecht: Well, you said it was gonna be a long trip. We'll be seeing a lot of neat things, right? So I thought I'd record it all in this. To show to my wife and kid, you know.
Hey, Braska. Ain't this supposed to be a grand occasion? Where're the cheering fans? The crying women?

text.Braska: This is it. Too many goodbyes — people think twice about leaving.

text.Jecht: Hmm ... If you say so. Well, it better be a lot more colorful when we come back. A parade for Braska, vanquisher of Sin!

text.Braska: (Chuckles) We should go. Day will break soon.

text.ACTION: Recording Jecht and Auron pose by Travel Agency

text.Braska: Auron, could you stand closer to him?

text.Auron: (Sighs, eventually stands closer but with his back to camera)

text.Braska: Good. (Tips camera up to frame "Lake Macalania" sign) That should do it.

text.Jecht: What's the matter? Afraid I might bite?
Braska! You should take one, too. It'd make a great gift for little Yuna!

text.Braska: (Nods) I suppose.

text.Auron: Lord Braska ... We shouldn't be wasting our time like this!

text.Jecht: What's the hurry, man?

text.Auron: (Growl) Let me tell you what the hurry is!

text.Braska: Auron!

text.ACTION: Recording Jecht sitting where they fought Spherimorph

text.Jecht: Hey. If you're sitting there, watching this ... it means you're stuck in Spira, like me. You might not know when you'll get back home, but you better not be crying! Although, I guess I'd understand. But you know what? There's a time when you have to stop crying and move on. You'll be fine. Remember, you're my son. And ... Well, uh ... Never mind. I'm no good at these things.

text.ACTION: [Approaches sphere and switches it off, but there's one last bit with no one on-camera]

text.Jecht: Anyways ... I believe in you. Be good. Goodbye.

text.ACTION: [Recording Dock of the S.S. Winno. Auron's PoV]

text.Jecht: Hey, Auron! Did you get that last match?

text.Auron: Yeah. But I don't understand why you wanted me to. Didn't you say you have blitzball in your Zanarkand?

text.Jecht: Not a sportsman, are ya?

text.Braska: Working on your form?

text.Jecht: My form don't need no work. I'm the great Jecht. It's for my kid.

text.Braska: Your son plays blitzball?

text.Jecht: Yeah, and he wants to beat his old man bad. Once, I told him to give it up. He didn't speak to me for a week. Wonder what he's doing now. I hope he got bigger and put on some muscle.
Hey, what's the big idea! Stop shooting!

text.ACTION: [Recording Braska and Jecht by Travel Agency, Auron's PoV]

text.Braska: A giant fiend that attacks chocobos ...

text.Jecht: Hmph. What's it waiting for? Hey! Come out and fight!

text.Auron: I told you this was a waste of time.

text.Jecht: Hey, come on! It's the right thing to do! Everyone's depending on us. Besides, it's good practice.

text.Braska: (Chuckles)
Well, then ...

text.ACTION: [There's a roar, and the camera suddenly falls. Auron's seen running off]

text.Jecht: There it is! Auron! Let's get 'im!

text.ACTION: [Braska pops into view, shuts it off]
[Pan across Braska staring out at lilies, Jecht lying under a tree. Later, zooms in on Jecht.]

text.Jecht: What are you shooting me for?

text.Auron: So you don't do anything stupid again. I can't believe you attacked that shoopuf. Lord Braska had to pay the handler for damages from his own travel money.

text.Jecht: I said I was sorry. It's never gonna happen again! I promise!

text.Auron: Ah, a promise? Which you'll forget come tomorrow!

text.Braska: Auron, please. He did apologize. He knows he was wrong.

text.Jecht: That's it. Only thing I drink from now on is shoopuf milk!

text.Braska: You're sure?

text.Jecht: We're on a journey to fight Sin and save Spira, right? If I keep screwin' up ... and ... making a fool of myself ... my wife and kid are never gonna forgive me.

text.ACTION: [Recording From Auron's PoV. Braska and Jecht posing, but the camera's wandering off of them]

text.Jecht: Hey! Hold it steady!

text.ACTION: [Sphere clicks off. Clicks back on to show Braska gazing north, Jecht at right edge of picture.]

text.Auron: What do you see there, my lord?

text.Braska: Oh, I was just ... thinking.

text.Jecht: (In distance) This is important! No foolin' around! (Camera pans to left and crops him out) You're gonna spoil it!

text.ACTION: [Flash of lightning]

text.Jecht: Whoa!

text.ACTION: [camera moves back to Jecht lying on ground]

text.Jecht: Whoa!

text.ACTION: [Camera moves towards Jecht muttering and picking himself up]

text.Braska: Are you all right?

text.Auron: Now there's a scene for posterity!

text.Jecht: Yeah, yeah ...

text.Braska: (Gales of laughter)

text.LOCATION: Jecht Sphere Aboard the S.S. Liki

text.ACTION: [Braska and Auron stand in the prow. Jecht's recording.]

text.Jecht: After you get that aeon from Besaid ... Where're we going?

text.Auron: Back the way we came. Then we go north from Bevelle and climb Mt. Gagazet.

text.Braska: Beyond it lies ... Zanarkand.

text.Jecht: Zanarkand, huh? It's been in ruins for a thousand years, right?

text.Auron: So the legends say. No one knows for sure. It still could be your Zanarkand.

text.Jecht: Thanks for trying, Auron.

text.ACTION: [Jecht sitting with back to camera up on the top deck. Braska recording.]

text.Jecht: I thought if I went with you guys I might find a way to go back. But it's not that easy.

text.Braska: I'm sorry.

text.Jecht: No need to apologize, Braska. It's not your fault. I should be thinking about fighting Sin now, anyway. Zanarkand can wait. But I will find my way back!

text.Braska: Be careful, Jecht.

text.Jecht: Hey, I'll be all right. You're the one that should be careful. Wouldn't want your little girl to cry.

text.Braska: She'll be all right. She's strong, like her mother was.

text.ACTION: Recording View of Besaid Village; Auron shooting.

text.Jecht: Smallest heap of huts I ever seen!

text.Braska: Now, that looks like a fine place to live. Hmm ... Auron.

text.ACTION: [View shifts to Braska standing just inside gate]

text.Braska: When this is over ... could you bring Yuna here? I want her to lead a life far away from this conflict.

text.ACTION: [View bobs slightly, evidently a nod]

text.Auron: You have my word. I will bring her here.

text.Braska: Thank you, Auron. You are a good friend.

text.Jecht: (From off-camera) What are you guys doin'? Let's go!

text.ACTION: [View shifts to Jecht in front of Merchant's Hut]

text.Jecht: I'm so hungry I could eat a shoopuf whole!

text.Braska: (Laughter) Sorry. Well, let's go then.

text.ACTION: [Recording Braska in foreground, Auron and Jecht in background by recently-passed grave]

text.Braska: Hello, Yuna. I hope you are well. I wonder how old you are, now that you're watching this sphere. You must be very beautiful, like your mother. I wish I could see you. Oh, by the way ... Jecht and Auron send their regards. So far, our journey has been very entertaining. Of course, it is a hard journey, but I have no regrets. It is the path I have chosen. Yuna, when you have grown, you will have to find your own path. Do what you must do, the way you want to do it. Doors will always open themselves to those who do. Listen close, Yuna. Your future is yours to make. Live the way you want to. Whatever way that may be, you have your father's full support. Yuna, I will always be with you.

text.ACTION: Recording Ocean overlook near Mi'hen Highroad Agency

text.Yuna: Sir Auron. Kimahri told me ... when my father wanted me taken from Bevelle to Besaid ... It was you who told Kimahri, right? I had always wanted to meet you someday. I am truly glad that I had that chance. Having you as a guardian was so great an honor I don't know how to thank you. Perhaps if I defeat Sin, that will be my thanks to you. That's what I'll do. Yes. I will challenge Sin. I will defeat Sin. If you are all there watching this, then I guess Sin is already gone. And so am I, I suppose. Anyway, I just wanted to say Sir Auron, I thank you.

Kimahri ... Do you remember the first day we met? I was only seven. My father had defeated Sin, and all Bevelle was celebrating. Everyone was saying what a hero my father was. I was so happy. But when night came, it occurred to me. My father had defeated Sin and now he was dead. Now, I was all alone. I couldn't sleep, so I wandered into the town, away from the celebrating crowds. I stood on the bridge in Bevelle where my father and I had parted. Standing there, alone, I could see the fields where he had fought Sin. Then, you appeared, Kimahri. You said you were looking for the daughter of Braska, remember? At first, I was so scared. Until I realized what a gentle person you are.

text.ACTION: (Laughs)

text.Yuna: You weren't used to talking to children. When I told you that I was Braska's daughter ... you said you would take me as far from Bevelle as you could. That it was the wish of a man facing death. I think ... I cried then. Because that ... that was when I knew my father was dead ... and I would never see him again. You just held me, without saying a word. I cried after we got to Besaid, too. When you tried to go after leaving me in the care of the temple ... I held onto you, crying, "Don't go, don't go!" And you listened, Kimahri. You stayed. Kimahri, thank you. Thank you so much. And I've always liked your broken horn.

Wakka, Lulu I'll never forget my days spent with you, growing up in Besaid. We always played together, us and Chappu. That's why I was always so happy, I think. And when you refused to let me become a summoner and I did it anyway ... I'm sorry. I've always wanted to apologize. You know, when you tried to stop me then–really, I was happy. I could tell you really cared about me. You were like my big brother and sister. No ... I think you really were my big brother and sister. What else ... I love watching you play blitzball, Wakka.

text.ACTION: (chuckles)

text.Yuna: I even love it when you scold me, Lulu! Really!

I guess that leaves ... the newest guardian. Star player of the Zanarkand Abes! You are ... I am ... Well, um ... I'm glad ... I'm glad that we met. We haven't even known each other that long, but ... It's funny. So ... So this is what it feels like. It's a much more wonderful feeling than anything I had ever imagined. Wonderful ... but it hurts, sometimes. I wonder. I ... I just want to say, thank you for everything. Maybe ... maybe that's why it hurts. When I ... When I think about us never being together again at all ... I'm afraid. No, I shouldn't say that. I'll do that part over. Um ...

text.ACTION: [Recording stops suddenly]
